title: SUFFOC AGM
text:
This year our AGM will be preceded by an event in Orwell Country Park. If you would like to take part, please ensure you have downloaded the MapRun app on to your mobile phone beforehand. If you haven’t used the app before we will be able to get you started on the day.

Following this social event, we will hold our club AGM in the car park of Bridge Wood (part of Orwell Country Park). Hopefully the weather will be good and we can hold it on the benches with our picnic lunches. If it rains, we will adjourn to Clive and Sally’s for the AGM.

If you have any items you would like to raise at the AGM please email secretary@suffoc.co.uk by 2 September 2025.

Annual General Meeting Date: Sunday 7 September 2025

MapRun Score Start: 10.45AM and finish by 11.30AM

AGM Time:12.00PM

Venue: Orwell Country Park

Agenda

1.Approval of minutes of 2024 AGM

2.Chairman’s report

3.Treasurer’s report and acceptance of accounts

4.Setting of annual subscription for 2025

5.Election of officers

6.Election of other committee members

7.Appointment of auditor

8.End of AGM

AOB: an opportunity for SUFFOC members to discuss anything about the club
